highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 advances to Skia m155 with servicing fixes and refreshed HarfBuzzSharp support.
highlights_body: It also updates GLES interop for pointer-based platform calls and disables RAW and DNG decoding while retaining source and binary compatibility.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone M155 and incorporates later upstream fixes, including corrections for failed-flush cache entries and FontConfig family matching.

bullets.lead: GLES platform interop uses explicit pointers
bullets.detail: GLES and WinUI EGL interop now use blittable pointer-based calls, with existing platform callers pinned explicitly instead of relying on managed array and string marshalling.
The HarfBuzzSharp update provides documented OpenType bit and number tag enums for usable native tag values without exposing raw native-shaped APIs.
The bundled decoder no longer accepts RAW or DNG images. The SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng value remains available for source and binary compatibility, but it does not indicate codec support.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Release Candidate 1 incorporates the final M155 servicing fixes before the stable release.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 updates HarfBuzzSharp, adopts pointer-based GLES interop, and disables RAW and DNG image decoding.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opens the 4.155 line with the Skia M155 renderer.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp now ships with HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and adds documented OpenType bit and number tag enums while keeping raw native fetch helpers internal.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia M155 engine line.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 2 refreshes HarfBuzzSharp and GLES platform interop.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: It also disables RAW and DNG image decoding while retaining the existing managed API identity.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the M155 line for release.
v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.body: It incorporates the latest M155 servicing fixes.
